description: A love song that is not a ballad: a bright major-key verse with a plain-spoken voice for 4:30, then the key and the floor fall out together at 4:30 (C# major -> G# minor at the valley), a rebuild, and a finale that ends louder than it starts with the voice gone — the machine answering the question at full volume, without words.
name: how_to_love

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest window in the track (-23.8dB at 0s), dark and muffled (centroid 1151Hz at 5s), level climbs to -13.8dB by 20s. No downbeat until 21.55s, no vocals. Sparse, patient.

sections.name: Verse A (vocals)
sections.notes: Vocals enter at 43.2s. C# major I-IV-V, key confidence 0.73-0.95. RMS holds a ~-15dB plateau for three minutes — the steadiest stretch in the track. Brightest timbre at 130s (centroid 3721Hz). Let it sit; the steadiness is the point.

sections.name: Dropout
sections.notes: One 8s hole (-19.7dB at 225s) at the end of the vocal verse. A full stop, not a breakdown — it separates the song's two halves.

sections.name: Peak burst
sections.notes: Slam back to -12.2dB at 235s, loudest pre-finale window -10.3dB at 260s. Short — 40 seconds — a burst, not a drop that settles.

sections.name: Valley + key turn
sections.notes: C# major -> G# minor at 270s, exactly as the level bottoms. Deepest sustained dip -20.5dB at 290-310s. Brightest timbre in the valley (~3250Hz) — exposed, not muffled. The key change IS the breakdown.

sections.name: Rebuild
sections.notes: G# minor, RMS climbing -14.5 to -13.1dB. E-major (VI) flashes at 420-450s. Steady climb, no dips — save the energy for the finale.

sections.name: Finale climb (voice out)
sections.notes: Loudest sustained passage (-9.9dB at 555s, peak -0.7dBFS at 460s). Vocals end at 497.3s; the last 87s are instrumental. Darkens as it gets louder (centroid ~2520Hz). End at full volume, no fade, no resolution — last key read G# min.

source_track: YOLO SNIPES - HOW TO LOVE (INTERNALISM track 03, 583.8s)
